opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search for a one-way or multi-city flight given origin, destination(s), date(s), passengers and direct-only, sort by Fastest, select a flight and choose the ticket type.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose the trip type (One way / Round trip / Multi-city)
Check 'Direct flights only' if required
Set the origin airport in 'Where from'
Set the destination airport in 'Where to'
Pick the departure date (and add more legs for multi-city)
Set the number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Apply the Direct only filter or a departure time filter if needed, then sort by Fastest
Click 'See flight' on the chosen result, then click Select
Choose Standard or Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way, direct only, BLR Bangalore → GOI Goa, Wed 29 Mar, 2 adults, departs 18:00-23:59, Fastest, SpiceJet 21:15, Flexible ticket
Multi-city: New York → Tokyo Thu 1 Jun, Tokyo → DEL Delhi Mon 5 Jun, 1 adult, Direct only, Fastest, Japan Airlines, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search for rental cars given a pickup/drop-off location, dates and times, then apply filters such as car type, capacity or rental company and sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click the Pick-up field and type the location, then choose a suggestion
Set the drop-off location, or leave it as 'Same as pick-up'
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, and click Done
Set the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filters (capacity, car type, rental company)
Change the sort order if needed

instances.values: Pick-up and drop-off JFK; dates first Apr 5-6, changed to Apr 3-6; 9:00 am to 6:00 pm; filters 2-5 passengers and Luxury; sort by Recommended (interrupted, resumed at 2179s)
Pick-up San Francisco, same drop-off, Apr 8-9, 10:30 am; filters Avis and Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search for cruises by destination, departure port and dates, then adjust the number of guests on the results page.
steps: Open the Carnival homepage
Click 'Sail To' and choose a destination
Click 'Sail From' and choose a departure port (optional)
Click 'Dates' and choose a month (optional)
Click 'Search Cruises'
On the results page, open 'Number of Guests' and set the count
Review the results and prices

instances.values: Sail to Panama Canal, sail from San Francisco CA, Oct 2024
Sail to Caribbean, guests 2 → 3 → 4 (interrupted by Kohl's browsing, resumed at 1078s)

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search for airport parking at a given airport, then set the start and end dates and sort the results.
steps: Open the SpotHero homepage
Click the 'Airport' tab
Click the search box and choose the airport from the list
On the results page, set the Parking Start Date and End Date
Change the sort dropdown (Featured) if needed

instances.values: JFK, Apr 18 to Apr 20, opened the sort dropdown

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: On the MTA site, open Planned Service Changes, enter a route and choose a date to see planned changes for that line.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Open Planned Work (top nav or menu → Planned Service Changes)
Type the route in 'Search Routes' and select it
Open the Select Date picker and choose the date
Review the results for that route

instances.values: Route 4, date moved from 04/12/2023 to May 3, 2023
